TerraClub

One membership across all five carriers. Earn points on every mile you fly, and keep them wherever you fly next.

Join TerraClub
Points are held on your account, not in this browser — so they follow you to your phone and can't be lost. Sign in or create an account to start earning.

Tiers

Seven rungs, named for altitude. Each one adds a bonus on everything you earn.

How you earn

Five points for every dollar of fare. Premium cabins earn more because they cost more.

Using your points

Any seat, any flight — an award costs whatever the fare costs, converted at 1.2¢ a point. Taxes are paid in cash. At five points a dollar, roughly seventeen paid trips cover a free one of the same value.

Award tickets don't earn points. Seats are subject to availability in the cabin you choose.

Lounges

Every group airline has a lounge at each of its hubs — somewhere quiet before you fly, with food, showers and Starlink Wi-Fi.
